orgs_discovered.evidence: 501(c)3 nonprofit offering chaplaincy services to soccer community. Accepts donations to support chaplaincy work and development. Evidence of structured development model with chaplaincy programs.

Christian-based 501(c)3 nonprofit founded by Dr. Madeline Manning Mims (four-time Olympian). Establishes presence of certified Sport Chaplains serving sports community through pastoral care and Christian outreach. Mission-driven staff supporting athlete ministry.

Established 1985, outreach to college and professional athletes with branches on 40 college campuses. Organizes annual conference for college athletes. Ministry staff serving at multiple campuses indicates personal support-raising structure.
Christian sports ministry focused on motorsports community. Operates chaplaincy and outreach programs with staff serving professional racing environments.
Christian outreach organization serving professional and amateur athletes. Ministry-focused structure suggests personal support fundraising model common in missionary organizations.
Faith-based 501(c)3 nonprofit committed to sharing message of Jesus Christ through extreme sports demonstrations and athlete ministry.
Community of believers in college and professional sports. Serves professionals and staff in sports industry with Christian discipleship and fellowship.
Major Christian youth sports organization. Operates through local church partnerships and has development/advancement staff structure for fundraising.
Bridge ministry to unchurched through amateur basketball competition. Operates as 501(c)3 with programming staff.
